description: This file is a code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page (MCQSet.aspx.cs) that handles the logic for setting up multiple-choice questions (MCQs), selecting courses and semesters, adding questions, and managing exam and question details in an online examination system.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: A partial class deriving from System.Web.UI.Page, managing MCQ question setup, course selection, exam creation, and navigation within the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently empty, potentially used for initialization.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester in the dropdown list.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database, updates question number, and alerts the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record in the database and navigates to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
